author: Harrier Studio
title: HARRIER STUDIO IS HIRING

Open until all positions are filled.

author: willai3213
title: Exhibition graphic design project collaboration
content: Looking for a graphic designer for an exhibition planned for early December at Huashan, Taipei. Scope includes main visual, wordmark, character visuals (6 designs, not too complex), character standees, window stickers, one banner flag, other exhibition derivatives, and print-ready proofing. Timeline: early Oct first drafts, mid Oct final main visual, early Nov all output designs, mid Nov to print, early Dec exhibition. Seeking someone with exhibition/graphic experience, hand-drawn Japanese warm style. Interested designers comment or DM with portfolio + quote.
